data.name: Hotel Emporio Ciudad de México
data.address: Av. P.º de la Reforma 124, Juárez, Cuauhtémoc, 06600 Ciudad de México, CDMX, Mexico
data.description:
This straightforward hotel in a modern building is a 12-minute walk from a metro stop, 2.7 km from lively Zócalo square in the city center, and 3.2 km from the National Museum of History, housed in Chapultepec Castle.
The unassuming rooms feature free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and DVD players, plus coffeemakers, minibars and whirlpool tubs. Suites add sitting areas. Room service is available 24/7.
There's an international restaurant and a cafe. Other amenities include a 24-hour gym, and a lobby lounge with a fireplace.
